title: Microsoft Forms: Copilot Chat pane and Surveys Agent for form authors
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing evidence and listed licence-management controls are supported. The statement that Microsoft names no further prerequisites is too broad: Microsoft's general Copilot requirements also require a Microsoft Entra work or school account and a supported browser for web experiences.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Cost and licensing; controls[0].note
claims.claim: Administrators can assign the Microsoft Copilot licence to individual users.
claims.quote: After you purchase licenses, assign the licenses to users in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: At least a License Administrator or User Administrator role is required to assign licences.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: User licence assignment is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote:
In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page.
Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to.
In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps.
Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Microsoft Graph PowerShell can assign a licence using Set-MgUserLicense with UserId, AddLicenses containing SkuId, and an empty RemoveLicenses array.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: An administrator can remove a user's product licence.
claims.quote: When you use the Active users page to unassign licenses, you remove product licenses from users.

claims.claim: Per-user Forms access is at Users > Active users > user > Manage product licenses > Licenses and Apps > Apps > Microsoft Forms in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote:
In the Microsoft 365 admin center, choose Users > Active users.
Select the box next to the name of the person
On the ribbon, click Manage product licenses.
On the account form that opens, on the Licenses and Apps tab, expand the Apps section and scroll down to the Microsoft Forms option.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses $addLicenses -RemoveLicenses @() can disable Forms when $addLicenses includes the Forms service plan in DisabledPlans.
The PowerShell article identifies FORMS_PLAN_E5 as the Forms service plan in its Microsoft 365 E5 disabling example.
claims.quote:
This example updates a user with SPE_E5 (Microsoft 365 E5) and turns off the Sway and Forms service plans while leaving the user's existing disabled plans in their current state:
Where ServicePlanName -in ("SWAY", "FORMS_PLAN_E5")

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The feature is user-opt-in: a licensed user chooses to open the pane through the Copilot icon.
claims.quote: Surveys Agent is available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and can be accessed by clicking the "Copilot" icon in Forms.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap description nor the feature's release-note entry says it changes anything for users who do not click the icon.
claims.quote: Searched: roadmap description and release-notes Forms entry for automatic actions or changes without clicking. Read both passages; release notes instruct users to open Forms and click Copilot, then ask for improvements, changes, invitations or analysis.

claims.quote: You can manage agents for Copilot by using the Microsoft 365 admin center. You can enable, disable, assign, block, or remove agents for your organization, and manage Copilot capabilities.

claims.claim: An administrator can block a listed agent across the organization from the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote:
Block and unblock | Restrict access to an agent across the organization, preventing any user from using it.
Select Agents > All agents.
In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn names no further prerequisite for the pane beyond access through the Copilot icon and the licence described elsewhere.
claims.quote:
Users must have a work or school account in Microsoft Entra ID.
Supported browser and cookies | Required for web-based experiences | Required for web-based experiences
Microsoft 365 and Copilot network requirements | Required | Required
claims.fix: Remove 'Microsoft Learn names no further prerequisite for the pane.' Microsoft's general Copilot identity, browser and network requirements apply to web-based Copilot experiences; the absence of an additional Forms-specific prerequisite does not establish that no further prerequisite is documented.

claims.claim: Copilot > Settings is an existing location for Copilot administration in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: As an administrator, you can manage many Microsoft Copilot settings from Copilot > Settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
